title: Central Subway: the federal profile against the project’s own later count
question: How far did the Central Subway’s cost and opening date move from what the federal grant agreement assumed?
finding: The Federal Transit Administration’s profile gives the cost under the 2012 grant agreement as $1.58 billion, with $942.2 million federal, and service due in December 2018; in December 2017 the project was about 69% complete and a year late. By June 2022 the agency’s own report put the estimate at completion at $1.93 billion, $353.0 million (22%) above the original budget, with opening expected in November 2022, nearly four years after the baseline.
how: Figures read from the FTA fiscal 2019 project profile and from SFMTA’s June 2022 quarterly progress report (already on disk with the capital-projects records); quotations checked against the text.
limits: Cost growth on a tunnel project has documented causes (ground conditions, utility relocation, contractor disputes, the pandemic); growth alone is not waste. The contractor-claims history is in the overruns screens and the case on construction change orders. The BART project is a regional agency’s and is shown for scale only.
